question: When Valve opened reservations for its Steam Frame VR headset in September 2026, it did not sell them first-come, first-served. Buyers were picked by random lottery. Why did Valve choose a lottery?
alternative_answers: To stop resellers buying them all up
So bots couldn't snap up the stock
To give real fans a fair chance
To prevent resale at inflated prices
source_excerpt: Valve plans Steam Machine reservation queue to fight scalpers at launch

topicality.rationale: Hardware launch logistics story, talked about for a few weeks.

extra.verification_notes: Steam Frame reservations were a randomized lottery in Sept 2026, and the Steam Machine queue it copies was reported as a scalper countermeasure; I found no Valve quote stating the motive directly.

explanation: On 14 September 2026 Valve opened reservations for the Steam Frame, its standalone VR headset priced from $1,059, through a randomised lottery. Valve did this to deter scalpers. In a first-come, first-served sale, resellers with bots grab most of the stock in seconds and then resell it at inflated prices. A random draw gives every real fan the same chance, however fast their clicking or software is. Valve had used a similar queue-and-lottery approach for earlier hardware. Every buyer also got Half-Life: Alyx included.

question: At Gamescom 2026, CD Projekt Red announced a remaster of its 2015 role-playing game, free for existing owners and including the expansions Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine. Which game?
source_excerpt: will not only feature the base game, but both the game's DLCs: "Hearts of Stone" and "Blood and Wine."

extra.why_interesting: The expansion names are a fan's foothold. The pleasant surprise is that a big remaster is free for people who already own the game.

topicality.rationale: Big remaster announcement from Gamescom, relevant for a season.

extra.verification_notes: Multiple outlets confirm The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered was announced at Gamescom ONL 2026 as a free upgrade including both expansions (https://www.cgmagonline.com/news/gamescom-onl-2026-the-witcher-iii-remastered/).

explanation: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered was a free upgrade for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series owners. A paid expansion called Songs of the Past was also announced for 2027.

question: Gamescom's 2026 'Heart of Gaming' jury prize went to Games Done Quick, whose charity marathons raise millions while players do what with video games?
alternative_answers: Finish them as fast as possible
source_excerpt: The charity speedrun marathons have raised more than $50 million.

extra.why_interesting: Players may not know this organisation, but the name holds the key. Working out that the players race through games for charity gives a satisfying aha.

topicality.rationale: Minor award at a trade show, fades within weeks.

extra.verification_notes: Search coverage confirms GDQ won the gamescom award 2026 Heart of Gaming special jury award, and GDQ is a charity speedrunning marathon, so the answer holds.

explanation: Games Done Quick streams marathon after marathon of players finishing games as fast as humanly possible, with viewers donating to charity as they watch.

question: The 2026 Esports World Cup was the first edition held outside Riyadh. Which European capital hosted it?
source_excerpt: Paris becomes the first international EWC Host City outside of Riyadh, accelerating the Esports Foundation's long-term global rotation ambition.

extra.why_interesting: The event had been tied to Saudi Arabia, so its move to Europe is news. A player can narrow it down to a handful of big European capitals.

topicality.rationale: Notable relocation of a major esports event, discussed over the season.

extra.verification_notes: EWC 2026 was moved to and held in Paris (Paris Expo Porte de Versailles) as the first edition outside Riyadh, and it concluded there; see https://esportsworldcup.com/en/press-releases/esports-world-cup-2026-to-be-hosted-in-paris

explanation: Paris hosted the event in summer 2026. China's All Gamers won the Club Championship and its seven-million-dollar prize for the first time.

question: In the Avatar series, the reincarnation cycle passed from airbender Aang to waterbender Korra. Following that cycle, which element does Pavi, the new Avatar of Seven Havens (2026), bend first?
source_excerpt: a young earthbender with a self-fashioned wooden prosthetic

extra.why_interesting: Even without knowing the new show, a fan can work it out from the Avatar cycle of Air, Water, Earth and Fire. It is a pure 'of course' moment.

topicality.rationale: New Avatar series premiere stays topical for a season.

extra.verification_notes: TheWrap's review calls Pavi an earthbender, consistent with the cycle where Earth follows Water; the review doesn't state which element she learned first.

explanation: The cycle runs Air, Water, Earth, Fire, so after Korra comes an Earthbender. Pavi's 26-episode story premiered on Paramount+ in October 2026.

question: The 2026 Ig Nobel Prize in Chemistry honoured a study of a milk whose proteins pack about three times the energy of cow's milk proteins. It isn't produced by a mammal but by an insect. Which kind?
source_excerpt: Cockroach milk research earns 2026 Ig Nobel Prize in Chemistry

extra.why_interesting: Players assume a super-milk must come from a mammal. The answer is the creature people least want to see in the kitchen.

topicality.rationale: Quirky annual Ig Nobel news, fades within weeks.

extra.verification_notes: Purdue confirms the 2026 Ig Nobel Prize in Chemistry honoured cockroach milk crystal research, so the answer 'cockroach' is correct.

explanation: The Pacific beetle cockroach gives birth to live young and feeds them a crystalline 'milk'. The Ig Nobels reward research that first makes you laugh, then makes you think.

question: In September 2026 Merriam-Webster officially added 'Rickroll' to its dictionary, the prank of tricking someone into clicking a link. Which 1987 song does the link always turn out to play?
alternative_answers: Never Gonna Give You Up by Rick Astley
source_excerpt: Merriam-Webster added about 1,400 new words and definitions, and "Rickroll" is among them (search-result summary, not a direct quote from the page).

extra.why_interesting: Most people have fallen for the prank at least once. The fun is in seeing an internet joke become an official dictionary word.

topicality.rationale: Dictionary addition is a short-lived fun news item.

extra.verification_notes: News coverage confirms Merriam-Webster's September 15 update added 'Rickroll', defined via Rick Astley's 1987 'Never Gonna Give You Up'; I did not open the articles to confirm the year.

explanation: Rick Astley's 1987 hit became the internet's favourite bait-and-switch. Nearly two decades later the prank earned a place in a major dictionary.

question: Tokyo Game Show 2026, held in late September at Makuhari Messe on the coast near Tokyo, drew over 250,000 visitors in four days. Yet the organisers cancelled its planned fifth day. Why?
alternative_answers: Hurricane (accept as the same weather phenomenon)
source_excerpt: Tokyo Game Show 2026 Cancels Day 5 Due to Incoming Typhoon

topicality.rationale: Quirky news item about a typhoon cancelling a TGS day; talked about for a few weeks.

extra.verification_notes: Trade press confirms CESA cancelled the Sept 21 fifth day of TGS 2026 because of an approaching typhoon, and four-day attendance was 257,642 (https://finalweapon.net/2026/09/19/tokyo-game-show-2026-cancels-day-5-due-to-incoming-typhoon/).

explanation: Tokyo Game Show 2026 ran from 17 to 20 September at Makuhari Messe in Chiba and drew 257,642 in-person visitors. The organiser, CESA, had planned a fifth day on 21 September but cancelled it because a typhoon was approaching. Late summer and early autumn is peak typhoon season in Japan, and a seaside convention centre packed with crowds is exactly what organisers don't want open during a storm.

question: At BlizzCon 2026, Blizzard revealed a Netflix animated series based on which of its dark fantasy franchises, named after the demon known as the Lord of Terror?
source_excerpt: We are thrilled to share that we are in development on a new animated series for Diablo with Netflix.

extra.why_interesting: Blizzard has several big franchises (Warcraft, Overwatch, StarCraft, Diablo). The 'Lord of Terror' clue lets a semi-gamer narrow it down to the right one.

topicality.rationale: Adaptation announcement at BlizzCon; moderate news lasting weeks.

extra.verification_notes: Blizzard announced an animated Diablo series with Netflix at the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony, and no newer event contradicts it (https://complex.com/pop-culture/a/treyalston/diablo-netflix-animated-series-blizzcon-2026).

explanation: Diablo, the demon-slaying series that began in 1996, is heading to Netflix as an animated show. It was announced at the same BlizzCon as World of Warcraft Forever.

question: The Ig Nobel Prizes, the spoof awards for research that first makes you laugh and then makes you think, were held outside the United States for the first time in 2026. In which Swiss city?
source_excerpt: The 2026 Ig Nobel Prizes were awarded at the 36th First Annual Ig Nobel Prize ceremony, in Zurich, Switzerland

extra.why_interesting: People connect the Ig Nobels with Harvard and Boston. Moving abroad is the twist, and 'Swiss city' leaves a short list that a player can reason through.

topicality.rationale: Novel venue move for the Ig Nobels; brief quirky news story.

extra.verification_notes: The 2026 Ig Nobel ceremony (Sept 3, 2026) was held at the Kongresshaus Zürich, its first outside the US; the next one is planned for Antwerp, so nothing supersedes it.

explanation: The 2026 ceremony moved to Zurich after more than three decades in the US. The plan is to keep travelling, with Antwerp next.

question: Named a Disney Legend at D23 in 2026, this actor has voiced characters in nearly every Walt Disney Animation film since Wreck-It Ralph, including the brainless rooster Heihei in Moana. He also played the sarcastic droid K-2SO in Rogue One. Who is he?
source_excerpt: Alan Tudyk was named a Disney Legend in the Film & Voice category at D23 2026

extra.why_interesting: Among the big-star honourees, the voice actor is the one hidden in plain sight. Players realise they have heard him in Disney film after Disney film without knowing his name.

topicality.rationale: Disney Legend honours at D23 are a short-lived entertainment news item.

extra.verification_notes: D23 confirms Alan Tudyk was named a Disney Legend in 2026, and his Heihei and K-2SO roles match the question.

explanation: Tudyk has become Disney Animation's good-luck charm, voicing everyone from King Candy to the Duke of Weselton in Frozen. Sci-fi fans also know him as the pilot Wash in Firefly.
